comment: A single national system may realise several reference components. The document does not require logical separation, independent data export, distinct governance, or replacement boundaries within such a platform.

anchor.note: p.86 l.Lines 1215-1222 read as the printed page; section 3.7.5 agrees

public.text: A single national system may realise several reference components. The document does not require logical separation, independent data export, distinct governance, or replacement boundaries within such a platform.
public.suggestedRevision: Require each realised component to remain separately identifiable through services, responsibilities, data ownership, conformance scope, portability, and lifecycle management, even when implemented in one platform.
